Commit after verification only.

Your heredoc is still open because the closing EOF was never pasted on its own line.
You are stuck inside:
Bashcat > KORELUMINA_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md <<'EOF'
To finish and save the file:
BashEOF
Must be:


uppercase


alone on its own line


no spaces before/after


Then press Enter.
After that verify:
Bashcat KORELUMINA_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md
If you want to abort instead:
Press:
BashCTRL + C
Then rerun the full command cleanly.
But the full file cannot be copied at once for EOF present at the bottom

Use nano instead. Much safer for large architecture files.
Run:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

nano KORELUMINA_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md
Then:


Paste the full architecture content


Press:


BashCTRL + O


Press Enter to save


Press:


BashCTRL + X
to exit
Verify:
Bashcat KORELUMINA_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md
For very large production docs, nano is more reliable than heredoc.
